Blue Sushi Sake Grill Happy Hour: Affordable Sushi and Drink Deals You’ll Love

Welcome to Blue Sushi Sake Grill, your ultimate destination for delicious and affordable sushi and drinks during their happy hour. Whether you’re a sushi purist or an adventurous eater looking for a creative sushi experience, this restaurant offers an impressive array of options to satisfy every palate. With a wide variety of sushi, sashimi, maki, nigiri, and Asian-inspired starters, paired with premium cold sake, cocktails, and a diverse drink menu, Blue Sushi Sake Grill is the perfect spot for a delightful meal. Let’s dive into everything you need to know about this restaurant’s happy hour deals, menu, and overall dining experience.

The Ultimate Sushi Experience at Blue Sushi Sake Grill

Blue Sushi Sake Grill is known for delivering a unique sushi experience that combines traditional flavors with modern twists. From the classic nigiri and sashimi to more inventive maki rolls, the restaurant provides an expansive selection that caters to all types of sushi lovers. Whether you are dining in Indianapolis, Lincoln, or other locations like Naperville or Omaha, you can enjoy a similar energetic vibe and an extraordinary sushi experience.

Blue Sushi Sake Grill Locations: Indianapolis, Lincoln, and More

Blue Sushi Sake Grill has multiple locations across the U.S., including Indianapolis, Lincoln, Naperville, Omaha, and Kansas. No matter which city you’re in, each restaurant brings the same energetic dining experience that keeps guests coming back for more. The vibe at Blue Sushi is lively and fun, with the restaurant often filled with families, coworkers, and groups of friends enjoying sushi together.

What’s the Vibe?

Each location, including Indianapolis and Lincoln, offers a vibrant, modern ambiance that’s perfect for both casual dining and special celebrations. The bar area is also a hit during happy hour, where you can sip on martinis, sake, and other premium drinks.

Drinks and Plates to Share

When dining at Blue Sushi Sake Grill during happy hour, sharing is a great way to experience more of the menu. With an array of sushi, drinks, and plates, there’s plenty to go around for everyone at the table.

Menu: A Diverse Range of Options

The menu at Blue Sushi Sake Grill caters to all preferences, whether you prefer traditional sushi or creative maki rolls with innovative twists. The restaurant’s sashimi and nigiri menu is complemented by Asian-inspired starters like salads and soups, making it a well-rounded dining experience.

Maki Rolls for Every Taste

You’ll find an exciting variety of maki rolls at Blue Sushi Sake Grill, offering something for both sushi purists and more adventurous eaters. Some notable options include:

Roll Type Description Key Ingredients

Creative Rolls A creative take on sushi, incorporating bold and fresh ingredients for a unique flavor experience. Mango, Jalapeno, Cilantro, Special Sauces

Sake, Cocktails, and More: The Drink Menu

No happy hour is complete without a stellar drink menu, and Blue Sushi Sake Grill does not disappoint. Their bar offers an impressive list of premium cold sake, martinis, and cocktails that perfectly complement the flavors of their sushi.

Premium Cold Sake

For those who enjoy sake, Blue Sushi Sake Grill offers an extensive list of premium cold sake. Whether you’re a seasoned sake lover or new to the drink, the knowledgeable staff can help you find the perfect bottle to pair with your meal.

Recommended Reviews from Sushi Lovers

According to restaurant reviews, diners appreciate not only the food but also the friendly service and inviting atmosphere. Many rave about the wide selection of vegan options, and the happy hour is a popular time to visit for both its affordability and quality.

FAQs About Blue Sushi Sake Grill

What are the happy hour hours at Blue Sushi Sake Grill?

The happy hour runs from Monday-Saturday from 2-6pm and all day Sunday. This is the perfect time to enjoy discounted sushi, drinks, and plates.

What vegan options are available at Blue Sushi?

Blue Sushi Sake Grill offers a variety of vegan maki rolls and plant-based dishes that are just as delicious as their non-vegan counterparts.

What drinks are included in the happy hour?

The happy hour drink menu includes a variety of cocktails, martinis, and premium cold sake. You’ll find something to pair with your favorite sushi rolls.

Conclusion: Enjoy Blue Sushi Sake Grill’s Happy Hour Deals

With a focus on fresh ingredients, creative dishes, and an energetic dining experience, Blue Sushi Sake Grill is a must-visit for sushi lovers. The happy hour provides an affordable way to enjoy an array of sushi, drinks, and plates. Whether you’re stopping in for a quick bite or gathering with friends for a leisurely meal, the restaurant’s relaxed atmosphere, fantastic sushi, and diverse drink menu make it the perfect place to dine. If you’re near one of their locations in Indianapolis, Lincoln, Naperville, or Omaha, be sure to take advantage of the happy hour and indulge in some of the best sushi and drinks in town.
